name: net_session_browser_dialog_on_ok
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::OnOK validates the player name, records modem or selected enumerated session state, updates the modem option, and only accepts the dialog after a valid selection path. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke patches ValidatePlayerName, RefreshSessionList, zOpt::SetNetworkModemEnabled, USER32 listbox/timer calls, and MFC CDialog::OnOK ordinal 4853 to isolate the branch behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b510 validates the thiscall ABI, ValidatePlayerName early return, non-modem SetNetworkModemEnabled(FALSE), KillTimer(hwnd, 2), LB_GETCURSEL, LB_GETITEMDATA into m_selectedSessionIndex, modem SetNetworkModemEnabled(TRUE), RefreshSessionList gate, modem selected index 0, and CDialog::OnOK only when the branch is accepted.

The native smoke verifies invalid-name early return, non-modem no-selection rejection, non-modem selected-session acceptance and item-data storage, modem refresh failure rejection, and modem refresh success with selected index 0 and OnOK dispatch.
